intro:
Celtic began their Scottish Premiership title defence with a narrow home victory thanks to a headed goal from Benjamin Nygren, according to BBC Sport. The match saw Nygren's header prove decisive as the Hoops saw off Dundee in their opening fixture of the campaign.

BBC Sport's coverage includes highlights of the game, which underlined a tight encounter that ultimately swung in Celtic's favour courtesy of the Swedish forward's aerial finish.

sections.heading: Match summary and the decisive moment
sections.text:
The standout, match-winning moment came from Benjamin Nygren, who scored with a header to earn Celtic a narrow victory at home over Dundee. BBC Sport's report highlights Nygren's goal as the crucial intervention that determined the result in a closely contested clash. Beyond that single fact, the coverage describes the win as a slim margin that nonetheless delivered the three points to the reigning champions.

As the report notes, there is visual coverage available through match highlights showing the key action. For supporters and analysts, that header will be the image that defines this opening-day fixture, providing Celtic with a positive start to the defence of their title.

sections.heading: Context: what this means for Celtic and Dundee
sections.text:
For Celtic, beginning a title defence with a victory at home carries both symbolic and practical value. In the Scottish Premiership — a 12-team top flight where consistency across the season is vital — taking points in early fixtures can set the tone for the campaign ahead. A narrow win, while encouraging, also signals areas where the squad might seek to strengthen performance as the season progresses.

Dundee, meanwhile, will take different lessons from a tight game decided by a single moment. Matches against the country’s traditionally dominant clubs are often decided by fine margins, and a close defeat away to Celtic can still contain positives to build upon. Both clubs will now turn their attention to the fixtures that follow in a league where early momentum can matter.

analysis:
This result provides a useful, if measured, reassurance for Celtic as they start the defence of their title. Securing a win at home — even by a narrow margin — can boost confidence and reward tactical plans, but it may also expose the club to questions about attacking fluency or defensive solidity that managers typically prefer to resolve early in the season. Benjamin Nygren's headed goal stands out as a timely contribution from a player who can be expected to influence Celtic's attacking play.

For Dundee, the match is a reminder that small details often decide encounters with the division's frontrunners. Analysts might see the game as evidence that Dundee can compete but also must find ways to convert chances and avoid isolated lapses that allow opponents a decisive opening. Both clubs will be watching the next rounds closely to see whether this fixture sets patterns for the months ahead.
